title: Connection, startup and checklist fixes
summary: Fixes the false "not connected" bar and long startup pause caused by slow MCP add-ons, silent crashes of the desktop app (OS Error 1450), AI chats that paste scripts instead of editing Studio, startup handshake errors, Notion tool results that stayed unsent, and task checklists that repeated the user's prompt.
improved: MCP add-ons (Blender, Context7, Fetch, Git, Memory, Sequential Thinking) now start in parallel and in the background, so Studio connects without waiting for them.
The task checklist shows short summaries of what the AI has to do, not the user's own sentences.
After Start, PlazCode tells the AI that Studio is connected; if the AI replies with a script to paste, PlazCode reminds it once to run the script itself.
fixed: The bar no longer shows "not connected" or "MCP is off" while the bridge and Studio are connected.
The long pause and near-freeze while commands load at startup.
The desktop app no longer ends in "PlazCode Agent crashed" (OS Error 1450): it relaunches itself silently, and crash dialogs can no longer freeze the app.
The AgentScript card no longer shows "local (0 tools)" next to "128 tools ready".
"Startup handshake failed" on Crax and other providers when the AI answered in prose first: PlazCode now asks once more.
Notion: a tool result left unsent in the composer is sent again once without typing continue.
notes: Automated regressions passed. Not yet tested live in Studio, Blender, Notion, Crax or ChatGPT. GLM's "No response" HTML error is a z.ai server error and is unchanged.

sections.title: 🔌 Connection
items: **No false "not connected":** slow MCP add-ons no longer block the Studio connection or startup.
**Faster startup:** add-ons start in parallel in the background.

sections.title: 🛠️ Agent fixes
items: **No more crash box:** OS Error 1450 relaunches the app silently.
**Handshake:** Crax and others get one correction instead of "Startup handshake failed".
**Studio access:** the AI is told Studio is connected and reminded once if it pastes a script.
**Notion:** an unsent tool result is sent again once.

sections.title: ✅ Task checklist
items: **Short titles:** steps summarise what the AI has to do instead of repeating your prompt.

sections.title: 🧪 Checks
items: Automated regressions passed. Not yet tested live in Studio, Blender, Notion, Crax or ChatGPT.
